title: 第2章 马车上路第3章 森林的鬼影
content_zh:
马车走出不远。
坐在车后面的凯斯说：“要是出事了记得躲咱周围，要是死了可就什么都没了，你那点小火苗还没到能扭转局势的地步。”
柯林点了点头。
由于装备和实力的问题，底层冒险者的死亡率一直居高不下。
当然，他敢接任务自然不是因为被贫困冲昏了头脑。
意念一动，一道显示自己属性的面板出现在柯林眼前。
-----------------
属性：
力量10、敏捷10、体质10、智力10、魅力10、感知10
熟练度：施法（生手）386500
法术：戏法【火焰箭】
-----------------
除了有个半兽人朋友之外，作为底层冒险者的原身自然也有自己的底牌——戏法【火焰箭】和一定的施法能力。
这个法术能在手中制造一小团火焰然后投掷出去，如果命中敌人的话也能造成一定伤害。
当然，这个法术并不是通过系统性学习得来的。
在成为一位底层冒险者之前，原身只是个码头苦力。
他在某天路过酒馆小巷时，忽然捡到了一张绘着奇怪字符的废纸。
觉得不对劲的原身花了一年的时间和许多存款，才从几个法师学徒口中知道这是一本法术书的其中一页，并且记载着一个最低级的戏法。
对那些高高在上的法师学徒而言，一个简单戏法只是入学考试的一环罢了。
但在一个码头苦力眼里，这却是能改变命运的机会。

原身一点点研究这些奇怪字符，一点点花钱从那些法师学徒身上买消息，花了数年时间，才学会了这个最简单的法术。
也多亏了这个原身才有了成为冒险者的勇气。
只不过最终这个法术也并没有给原身带来多少优势。
柯林看着面板上的【火焰箭】集中精神。
法术本身的效果随即出现在眼前。
【火焰箭】：射程40米，伤害1-10点。
柯林最近特意去二手市场看过，一把普通猎弓伤害大概是1-8点。
也就是说这个法术最多算点了火的箭矢。
要说有用肯定是有用的，但要是算上原身耗费的精力和金钱的话，就有些难以评价了。
在柯林思考的时候，车夫试着向半兽人搭话：“你是北边来的吗？额……先生。”
他说话的语气让柯林想起了喜欢聊天的出租车司机。
“很北的北边。”
“你应该很能打，对吧？”车夫继续发问。
凯斯听到这话，嘴唇一咧呲出一口雪白的獠牙。
content_en:
The carriage was not far away.
Keith, who was sitting in the back of the car, said: "If something happens, remember to stay away from us. If you die, there will be nothing. Your little flame is not enough to turn the situation around."
Colin nodded.
Due to problems with equipment and strength, the mortality rate of low-level adventurers has always been high.
Of course, his daring to take on the task was not because he was blinded by poverty.
With a thought, a panel showing his attributes appeared in front of Colin.
------------------
Properties:
Strength 10, Agility 10, Constitution 10, Intelligence 10, Charisma 10, Perception 10
Proficiency: Spellcasting (Beginner) 386500
Spell: Cantrip [Fire Arrow]
------------------
In addition to having a half-orc friend, the original person, as a low-level adventurer, naturally also has his own trump card - the magic [Fire Arrow] and certain spell-casting abilities.
This spell creates a small ball of flame in the hand and throws it out, causing some damage if it hits an enemy.
Of course, this spell is not learned through systematic learning.
Before becoming a low-level adventurer, he was just a dock coolie.
One day when he was passing by a tavern alley, he suddenly picked up a piece of waste paper with strange characters on it.
Feeling something was wrong, it took the original person a year and a lot of savings to learn from several mage apprentices that this was a page from a spell book, and that it recorded the lowest level of magic.
For those high-ranking mage apprentices, a simple trick is just part of the entrance exam.
But in the eyes of a dock coolie, this is an opportunity that can change his destiny.
The original person studied these strange characters bit by bit and spent money to buy information from those mage apprentices. It took him several years to learn this simplest spell.
Thanks to this original person, I had the courage to become an adventurer.
But in the end, this spell didn't bring much advantage to the original body.
Colin looked at the [Fire Arrow] on the panel and concentrated.
The effects of the spell itself appear immediately.
[Flame Arrow]: Range 40 meters, damage 1-10 points.
Colin recently went to the second-hand market to see that the damage of an ordinary hunting bow is about 1-8 points.
In other words, this spell can count as a fire arrow at most.
To say it is useful, it is definitely useful, but if you include the energy and money spent by the original body, it is a bit difficult to evaluate.
While Colin was thinking, the coachman tried to talk to the orc: "Are you from the north? Uh... sir."
The tone of his voice reminded Colin of a chatty taxi driver.
"Very far north."
"You should be very good at fighting, right?" the coachman continued to ask.
When Keith heard this, his lips showed a mouth of snow-white fangs.
